answer: Give each agent a uniqueness credential issued once per real person by independent, privacy-preserving issuers: a zero-knowledge pass proves the holder is a distinct human without revealing who they are, like a single pulse that can only beat in one place. One person, one credential, so a river of fake accounts dries up at its source - an attacker cannot mint a thousand identities without a thousand real people. Credentials are revocable if abused and drift, light as a zephyr, between issuers so no single authority can gatekeep the whole economy.
